castle.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castle.rhyme_1:
Welcome, O travelers, to the fortress of old,
watching the valley as history unrolled.
Perched on the mountain of fierce living stone,
guardian of dreams and mysteries unknown.
castle.rhyme_2:
Within these grand walls that challenge all time,
dynasties faded like a poet's brief rhyme.
From proud Chiaramonte to Despuches of fame,
every room whispers of glory and name.
castle.rhyme_3:
Seek not for dates in a cold, dusty page,
but watch the shadows dance soft on the stage.
The Castellana awaits on your way,
to unveil Sister Felicia's secret today.
castle.welcomemsg_felicia: Welcome to the Castle of Caccamo, stranger. I am Sister Felicia. Would you like me to reveal the secrets of the Conspiracy Hall, or do you prefer to hear the ancient legends of the manor? Just ask me.
castle.position: A fortress perched on a rocky spur, dominating the valley view.
castle.defense: Loopholes, thick walls, and battlements recount its defensive purpose.
castle.conspiracy: Secret rooms and noble halls were the stage for medieval conspiracies and intrigues.
castle.prisons: The underground prisons still preserve the traces of ancient captivity.
castle.legend_brothers: The legend of the two brothers tells of a fatal duel fought for a lady's love.

castello.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castello.description: The Castle of Caccamo is among the largest and best-preserved Norman fortresses in Sicily. Perched on living rock since the 11th century, it dominates the San Leonardo valley with its imposing walls, watchtowers, and suggestive internal halls that evoke centuries of feudal history and chivalric legends.

badia.title: Church of San Benedetto alla Badia
badia.description: A true jewel of Sicilian Baroque, the church is famous worldwide for its extraordinary floor entirely made of 18th-century majolica, depicting allegorical scenes and naturalistic motifs of rare mastery. A masterpiece of visual art suspended in time.
badia.hours: Tue - Sun: 09:00 – 12:30 | Mon: 14:40 – 18:30 (No regular service, ideal for visits)
badia.tickets: Full € 2.00 | Reduced € 1.00 (EU Youth 18-25 or with Castle ticket on the same day) | Free under 18

santamaria.title: Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli
santamaria.description: Founded in the 15th century together with the Dominican convent, the Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli is one of the most important spiritual centers of the borough. It houses the remains and relics of Blessed Giovanni Liccio, Patron of Caccamo. Inside, you can admire splendid marble altars and sacred artworks testifying to centuries of deep devotion and pilgrimages.
santamaria.hours: Opening and Visits: Saturday from 16:00 to 17:30 | Sunday from 09:00 to 10:00 and from 11:00 to 12:30. (Holy Masses: Saturday 17:30 | Sunday 10:00).

sangiorgio.title: Church of San Giorgio Martire
sangiorgio.description: The Mother Church of Caccamo, dedicated to Saint George the Martyr, is an imposing masterpiece dominating the monumental square below the Castle. Founded in the Norman era and rebuilt in 1614, it preserves an immense artistic heritage: from Gaginiana school sculptures to precious 17th-century canvases by the Flemish painter Matthias Stom, up to rich chapels decorated with mixed marbles.
sangiorgio.hours: Visit Time Slots: Saturday and Sunday 09:30 – 10:45 and 16:00 – 18:00. (Tourist reception is suspended during the Sunday Holy Mass at 11:00).

annunziata.title: SS. Annunziata Parish
annunziata.description: Set within the medieval urban fabric, the church stands out for its facade and the atmosphere of deep spirituality felt inside. It preserves finely decorated altars and artistic artifacts that attract visitors and worshipers.
annunziata.hours: Mon - Sat: 09:00 – 12:00 | Weekday Masses at 18:00. Sundays and Holidays visit slots: 08:30 - 09:30 and 10:30 - 12:00 (Festive Masses at 09:30, 12:00, 19:00).

cappuccini.title: Convent of the Capuchin Friars
cappuccini.description: A place of silence, meditation, and history, the structures of the Convent are deeply linked to the Franciscan tradition in Sicily. In addition to the conventual structure, the area offers an authentic insight into monastic life and popular devotion.
cappuccini.hours: Accessible mainly upon request or during Franciscan anniversaries. Contact the Tourism Office.
cappuccini.secret_info: 💡 The Hidden Jewels of Caccamo: The borough houses 33 churches. Use the Din Don Dan map and zoom in on Caccamo to discover real-time hours and openings of lesser-known treasures like the Church of San Rocco and other small widespread masterpieces.
